skill.name: learn-off
skill.description: Disable continuous learning mode while keeping existing knowledge and manual learning available.
skill.summary: Turns off automatic insight extraction for the current knowledge workflow.
skill.author: 0xrdan

content.value_statement: Continuous learning can keep extracting insights after a focused session ends. This skill turns it off and confirms the learning state clearly.
actual_capabilities: Sets learning_mode to false in knowledge/state.json.
Clears learning_mode_since by setting it to null.
Stops automatic insight extraction for future interactions.
Stops query counting while continuous learning is disabled.
Confirms the disabled state with a short session summary.
limitations: Does not delete existing captured insights.
Requires knowledge/state.json to be available for state updates.
Does not re-enable learning mode; use /learn-on for that action.

use_cases.title: End a focused learning session
use_cases.description: Turn off automatic insight extraction when a research or coding session is complete.

use_cases.title: Pause workspace insight capture
use_cases.description: Stop background learning before switching to unrelated tasks or sensitive discussion.

use_cases.title: Keep manual knowledge capture
use_cases.description: Disable automatic capture while preserving manual commands for selected insights.

prompt_templates.title: Turn Learning Off
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for the default action.
prompt_templates.prompt: Disable continuous learning mode now and show the status summary.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Existing Knowledge
prompt_templates.scenario: Confirm that stored insights remain available.
prompt_templates.prompt: Disable continuous learning, preserve existing knowledge, and tell me whether manual /learn remains available.

prompt_templates.title: Review Session Counts
prompt_templates.scenario: Request a state change with available metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the current learning state, switch continuous learning off, and provide extraction, query, and insight counts if present.

prompt_templates.title: Close A Project Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a precise state update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Disable learning mode after this project review, update only the learning state, and give a concise completion note with any missing count fields called out.

output_examples.output: Continuous Learning: DISABLED. Learning mode is now inactive. Manual extraction remains available through /learn.

output_examples.input: Turn learning off and summarize the session counts.
output_examples.output: Continuous learning is disabled. The summary lists available extraction, query, and insight counts, and notes any values that were not recorded.

output_examples.input: Stop automatic learning but keep existing knowledge.
output_examples.output: Automatic insight extraction is off. Existing knowledge remains available, and the knowledge base can still be viewed separately.

best_practices: Use this skill when a focused learning session is complete.
Review the summary to confirm the learning state changed as expected.
Use manual /learn for selected insights after automatic capture is disabled.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill when you want continuous learning to keep running.
Do not expect this skill to remove stored knowledge.
Do not use it as a replacement for reviewing sensitive workspace data policies.

faq.question: Does this delete existing knowledge?
faq.answer: No. It only disables continuous learning mode and keeps captured insights available.

faq.question: Can I still use /learn after running it?
faq.answer: Yes. Manual /learn commands remain available for selected insight capture.

faq.question: What file does it update?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to update knowledge/state.json with the disabled learning state.

faq.question: Does it stop query counting?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill states that query counting stops when continuous learning is disabled.

faq.question: How do I turn learning back on?
faq.answer: Use the related /learn-on command when you want automatic learning to resume.

faq.question: Is this skill for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
